About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role


As an AI Solutions Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of customers, AI delivery, and Ramp’s core product teams. You will partner with enterprise/strategic customers to deeply understand their finance workflows—especially corporate finance and controllership priorities like close, controls, and spend governance—identify high-impact opportunities for AI and automation, and translate those needs into clear problem statements, solution designs, and actionable feedback for Ramp’s Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams.

This role is for someone who can listen carefully, structure ambiguity, and turn on-the-ground learnings into scalable solutions. This role required high proactivity and bias to action.

 

What You'll Do

  • Discover and diagnose customer needs. Run stakeholder interviews and workflow deep dives with Finance, Procurement, AP, and IT teams. Map end-to-end processes and identify the underlying drivers behind pain points — risk, cost, cycle time, compliance, exception volume, and operational complexity.

  • Translate needs into solution requirements. Turn qualitative input into crisp artifacts: problem statements, success metrics, constraints, acceptance criteria, and deployment plans. Balance speed, safety, and scalability across MVPs, iterations, and broader rollouts.

  • Partner with technical teams to implement AI workflows. Work closely with Ramp engineers and AI builders to design and ship solutions that meet real customer workflows. Specify data inputs, integrations, governance needs, policy rules, auditability requirements, and edge cases.

  • Drive feedback loops into Ramp's product. Synthesize learnings across customers into reusable patterns and product opportunities. Write high-signal briefs for Product and Engineering that explain what customers need, why it matters, and what should be built next.

  • Communicate impact and guide executives. Present status, outcomes, and recommendations to customer operators, executives, and internal stakeholders. Quantify impact through time saved, error reduction, improved compliance, faster close, and other business outcomes.

 

What You Need

  • 4+ years of relevant experience

  • Strong customer empathy and the ability to earn trust quickly with senior stakeholders.

  • Excellent problem framing: you can turn messy workflows into clear systems and priorities.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly while keeping quality high.

  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing (briefs, requirements, postmortems) and verbally (workshops, exec readouts).

  • A builder mindset: you like shipping, learning, and improving the system.

  • Experience in solutions, implementation, product strategy, consulting, or technical program management.

  • Strong grounding in corporate finance / controllership workflows, including accounting close, spend governance/controls, budgeting, procurement, and AP operations.

  • Experience translating finance requirements into system design and configuration (e.g., ERP/accounting, procurement, expense management, payments), including integrations, data mapping, and controls.

  • Ability to partner with finance system owners/admins to drive change management, testing (UAT), and successful rollouts.

  • Familiarity with finance operations workflows (AP, procurement, expenses, cards, accounting close).

  • Exposure to AI-enabled products, automation, or applied ML (you do not need to be an ML engineer).

  • Basic comfort with data concepts and systems integration (APIs, ETL, SQL, spreadsheets, data quality).

 

Working style

We collaborate best when we’re close to the work and close to each other. This role is hybrid in New York, with time in-office to partner tightly with product and engineering teams. Importantly, this role required spending time with customers to understand real workflows, so travel and flexibility are critical to success.

Ramp's Accounting Channel is a key growth driver for the company, and we're looking for a founding Channel Partner Manager to help build our UK accounting-partner motion from the ground up. As an early member of the team in London, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Ramp partners with accounting and advisory firms across the region; building the relationships, go-to-market strategy, and repeatable motions that fuel long-term growth.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and takes ownership without being handed a playbook. You'll acquire and grow relationships with accounting and advisory partners, enable their teams, and generate revenue through client referrals. You'll also help us adapt Ramp's partner strategy to the commercial and cultural nuances of the UK markets.

  • Source, qualify, and conduct deep discovery with net-new accounting and advisory partners across the UK

  • Sign partners and build comprehensive go-to-market plans that create a scalable referral motion

  • Drive revenue for Ramp by generating and converting client referrals from accounting firms

  • Build relationships with multiple stakeholders within partner firms, from firm leadership to client-facing teams

  • Educate partners on Ramp's offering and clearly articulate the value we deliver to both their firms and their clients

  • Enable and onboard partner team members so they can confidently identify, position, and refer Ramp

  • Hold monthly and quarterly business reviews with key partners; use performance data and feedback to identify new growth opportunities

  • Adapt your approach to the cultural, commercial, and regulatory nuances of the UK accounting landscape

  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, growth, direct sales, and product and engineering to develop co-marketing opportunities, onboard referred clients, and inform the product roadmap

  • Become an expert in Ramp's product, features, and workflows

  • Build new (and improve existing) workflows, sales motions, and partner programs that contribute to the team's continued success

  • Own partner activity, pipeline, forecasts, and revenue targets with disciplined follow-through and CRM hygiene

What You Need

  • AI fluency as a daily habit. Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment

  • 4+ years of experience in partner sales, business development, partnership management, full-cycle sales, or channel partnerships

  • Strong discovery skills and a consultative approach to uncovering partner pain points and growth opportunities

  • A track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets and quotas

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate with high autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment

  • A strong bias for action, with a dedication to tracking performance and improving efficiency every day

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong listening and stakeholder-management skills

  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior and day-to-day stakeholders, both externally and across the company

  • Ability to work five days per week from our London office, with willingness to travel across the UK

Nice to Haves

  • Experience partnering with accounting firms in a consulting, sales, or partnerships capacity

  • Knowledge of the UK accounting and advisory ecosystem

  • Background or proficiency in accounting

  • Experience launching a new territory, vertical, or partner program

  • Experience in a direct sales closing role

  • Fluency in additional European languages

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely in 2025 and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Post Sales, GTM, and Quote-to-Cash teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. This is a key role where you will be uniquely positioned to impact the full picture of Ramp’s growth efforts through systems development.

What You’ll Do

  • Work alongside Finance Operations to administer key go-to-market business systems, including Salesforce, Leandata, Outreach, Gong.io, Chili Piper, ZoomInfo and Workato Build and deploy automation (flows), validations, and applications in Salesforce

  • Enhance existing systems and implement new features servicing our Customer Success, Account Management, and Solutions Teams.

  • Analyze key business requirements and systems capabilities to write specifications for systems build and run end-to-end implementation

  • Write and maintain clear documentation on systems build and integrations with other business systems

What You’ll Need

  • 3+ years of experience in sales/revenue operations or business systems in a fast-paced environment

  • You have Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent experience

  • You’re a master with Salesforce and GTM automation tools (LeanData, Outreach, ChiliPiper, Workato, Hightouch), and other GTM tools & systems alike, and can learn new systems quickly

  • You leverage AI tools to automate workflows and processes

  • You love getting in the weeds to build elegant, efficient and scalable solutions

  • You’re a structured thinker with a natural capacity to distill complex concepts and effectively communicate them to a variety of audiences

  • You have a “get things done” mentality; you can dissect problems, identify solutions, and drive these solutions to completion with a high degree of autonomy

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in high-growth startups and/or high-growth technology companies

  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools

  • Experience with Linear or similar project management software

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Business Systems Engineer to own and evolve Ramp’s Post Sales systems. You’ll build the products that fuel our onboarding and activation funnel, turn complex commercial agreements into accurate, supportable customer outcomes from original deal closure through expansions, and book of business management

This role sits in Growth Engineering’s Business Systems Engineering team and partners closely with Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Data, Product, and GTM teams. You’ll combine hands-on Salesforce engineering with systems design and strong commercial judgment to make high-stakes revenue workflows reliable, scalable, and easier for teams to use.

 


What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy applications on the Salesforce Platform

  • Design and operate reliable integrations between Salesforce, our internal revenue app, Data, and adjacent business systems. Own data contracts, idempotency, error handling, reconciliation, and safe lifecycle changes for quotes, contracts, and subscriptions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain solutions on iPaaS (Homegrown, Workato, Clay, etc)

  • Drive decisions on architecture patterns, tool usage, and designs required for the solution to scale both in terms of speed and scale.

  • Write and communicate technical specifications, including architecture diagrams, data model diagrams, process flows, and sequence diagrams.

  • Own the data integrity and data assumptions in your focused area and contribute continually.

  • Work closely with the rest of the team on code reviews, on-call, build issues, and ideation.

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years working with the Salesforce platform

  • 5+ years of experience with Systems Architecture and Integrations

  • Strong experience with Apex and triggers.

  • Working knowledge and experience on other programming languages like Python.

  • Strong knowledge of developing Lightning Web Components

  • Strong experience of APIs and integrations with Salesforce

  • Strong knowledge and working experience of synchronous/asynchronous methods, streaming API, and publish/subscribe design patterns and architectural patterns.

  • Familiarity with broader GTM stack beyond Salesforce ( Gong, Leandata, CPQ, Billing Systems)

  • Strong and working knowledge of data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding or implementation knowledge of CI/CD processes.

  • Understanding Salesforce governance limits and code coverage.

  • Follow unit-testing best practices and be capable of coding for positive/negative scenarios.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and evaluating their output.

  • Deep experience building and maintaining Salesforce applications with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and asynchronous processing.

  • Experience with CPQ, pricing, contract lifecycle management, billing, subscriptions, or another Quote-to-Cash domain.

  • Strong API and integration-design skills, including reliable handling of retries, duplicate events, partial failures, and data reconciliation.

  • Ability to translate complex commercial requirements into simple, durable system behavior in partnership with non-engineering teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Snowflake/DBT

  • Kafka experience

  • Experience with Agile methodologies

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

You’ll build and maintain Ramp’s Salesforce-based quoting platform, contract workflows, and Billing/Core integrations that turn complex commercial agreements into accurate, supportable customer outcomes—from quote creation and approvals through order forms, provisioning, billing, renewals, and amendments.

This is not a Salesforce CPQ implementation role. Ramp uses an in-house Quote-to-Cash platform built on Salesforce, so we’re looking for a strong Salesforce engineer with experience in quoting, pricing, contracts, billing, subscriptions, or other complex commercial workflows.

This role sits in Growth Engineering’s Business Systems Engineering team and partners closely with Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Billing Engineering, Product, and GTM teams. You’ll combine hands-on Salesforce engineering with systems design and strong commercial judgment to make high-stakes revenue workflows reliable, scalable, and easier for teams to use.

 
 

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy applications on the Salesforce Platform.

  • Design, build, and operate Ramp’s Salesforce-based Quote-to-Cash platform and the integrations between Salesforce, Ironclad, Billing/Core, and adjacent business systems. Own data contracts, idempotency, error handling, reconciliation, and safe lifecycle changes for quotes, contracts, and subscriptions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using in-house services and approved automation platforms.

  • Drive architecture, tooling, and design decisions that keep commercial systems fast, reliable, and scalable.

  • Write and communicate technical specifications, including architecture diagrams, data models, process flows, and sequence diagrams.

  • Own data integrity and the operating assumptions for your domain; continually improve them.

  • Partner with the rest of the team on code reviews, operational support, debugging, and solution design.

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years building applications on the Salesforce Platform.

  • 5+ years of systems architecture and integration experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and asynchronous processing.

  • Working knowledge of another programming language, such as Python.

  • Strong API and integration-design skills, including reliable handling of retries, duplicate events, partial failures, and data reconciliation.

  • Experience with Quote-to-Cash domains such as quoting, pricing, approvals, contract lifecycle management, billing, subscriptions, renewals, or amendments. Experience with Salesforce CPQ is welcome but not required.

  • Familiarity with the broader GTM stack beyond Salesforce, such as Gong, LeanData, contract lifecycle management, billing, or revenue systems.

  • Strong knowledge of synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns, streaming APIs, and publish/subscribe architectures.

  • Working knowledge of data pipelines, CI/CD, Salesforce platform limits, code coverage, and unit-testing practices.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex commercial requirements into simple, durable system behavior with non-engineering partners.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and evaluating their output.

Nice to Haves

  • Snowflake/DBT

  • Kafka experience

  • Experience with Agile methodologies

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As the founding Channel Partner Manager for Canada, you will build the partner motion that helps Canadian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt Ramp through trusted advisors and ecosystem partners.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the full partner lifecycle, from identifying and engaging Canadian accounting, advisory, private equity, and venture capital partners through signing, enablement, activation, and partner-sourced pipeline. Your early results will help determine how Ramp scales its Canadian channel motion.

You will work closely with Sales, Growth, Product, Engineering, and the broader Partnerships organization. The right person is a hands-on builder: equally comfortable opening a new relationship, running a partner meeting, solving an operational blocker, and turning early learnings into a repeatable playbook.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Ramp’s Canadian channel strategy and operating rhythm from the ground up.

  • Research, identify, source, qualify and sign net-new Canadian partners.

  • Create joint go-to-market and activation plans to grow the Canadian partner ecosystem.

  • Drive revenue for Ramp through generating referrals

  • Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and operators inside partner orgs

  • Educate partners on Ramp’s Canadian capabilities, value prop and updates.

  • Own partner onboarding, activation, pipeline generation, and regular business reviews.

  • Work closely with the Canadian Sales team to advance partner-referred opportunities.

  • Partner with Product to surface recurring partner needs and inform the Canadian roadmap.

What You’ll Need

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years in partner sales, business development, channel partnerships, or a closely related role

  • High agency, urgency, and resilience

  • Proven track record of sourcing and managing partnerships

  • Self-starter mindset: you are comfortable getting in the weeds

  • Strong discovery and consultative-selling skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Strong operating discipline and comfort using data to improve performance.

  • Proven ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong cross-functional judgment and a history of finding success across cross-functional work

  • Familiarity with the Canadian business and technology ecosystem

  • Strong comfort using AI tools to execute quality work, fast

  • Ability to travel to in-person events in Canada frequently

Nice to Have

  • Experience building a new partner motion, market, or vertical from an early stage.

  • Professional proficiency or native-level fluency in French

  • Presence in the Canadian accounting, advisory, private equity, venture capital, financial-services, or technology partner network

  • Familiarity with finance & accounting workflows and solutions

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Social at Ramp exists to make the company more visible, culturally relevant, and useful to the people we want to reach. We are looking for a highly strategic Social Media Lead to turn that ambition into an operating system.

Your central job is to build the strategy and operating system for Ramp social. You will bring a clear point of view, make the right calls about where and how Ramp shows up, and ensure our biggest moments have real distribution behind them. You will help more Ramp employees credibly tell the stories closest to their work. You may also be hands-on where it matters, but strategic leadership and operational ownership are what will define success in this role.

What You'll Do

  • Set Ramp’s social strategy, raise the creative bar, and focus the calendar on fewer, more consequential moments.

  • Decide when Ramp, an employee, executive, creator, customer, or partner should lead the story, then build the right distribution plan around it.

  • Help more Ramplings and executives post credibly about their work, with clear guidance, coaching, and amplification.

  • Build a reliable approach to community management and social support, including the right contractor bench.

  • Bring together producers, influencer, Brand, Comms, Growth, Support, and visibility teams to execute the highest-priority work.

  • Establish a clear scorecard and use social insights to improve the work over time.

What success looks like

  • Ramp has a clear social point of view, distinct roles for each channel, and a calendar built around high-conviction moments rather than constant posting.

  • The social function is a strategic driver of visibility and demand, not an internal posting service.

  • Employees and executives have an easy, trusted way to share their work, and the strongest posts receive coordinated amplification.

  • Product questions and customer issues found on social are handled with dependable ownership and follow-through.

  • Social has data driven goals and learnings, including reach, awareness, demand, campaign lift, and market insights.

What you bring

  • 2+ years leading strategic social, or related marketing programs at a top-tier technology, consumer or media company.

  • A demonstrated ability to build social strategy and the operating model behind it: prioritization, agency management, workflows, measurement, and executive alignment.

  • Excellent editorial judgment and an instinct for what will feel credible and native on each platform, especially LinkedIn, X, Meta, YouTube, and emerging community channels.

  • Comfort with performance and brand measurement, including how to distinguish correlation from impact and how to run disciplined tests.

How we work

We make finance teams cool. That means taking ideas further, choosing fewer bets with more force, and creating work people genuinely want to talk about. We value sharp taste, clear thinking, generous collaboration, and the willingness to say no when a moment does not meet the bar.

Ramp is committed to supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

You will serve as a front-line manager for a team of Sales Development Representatives, responsible for outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Ramp’s SMB segment.

You will lead and evolve the SMB sales development motion by providing 1:1 coaching, onboarding, training, and mentorship; setting team strategy; and partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Executive Leadership to drive pipeline and business outcomes.

As a member of the Sales Leadership team, you will play a critical role in developing SDR talent, scaling effective outbound practices, and continuously refining Ramp’s SMB go-to-market motion.

What You'll Do

  • Build and scale the SMB SDR function by evolving team operating rhythms, playbooks, coaching standards, and processes for an open-territory outbound motion.

  • Set and maintain a high-performing culture by overseeing daily SDR activity, pipeline generation, and quota performance to ensure key performance metrics are met.

  • Hire, onboard, and train new SDRs on Ramp’s products, buyer personas, competitive landscape, prospecting strategy, and tools through hands-on methods including role-plays.

  • Develop and execute career-growth and leadership plans for direct reports, including daily 1:1 mentorship and coaching on time management, objection handling, prospecting tactics, active listening, and pipeline creation.

  • Coach SDRs on effective multichannel outbound prospecting, including account research, relevant messaging, call execution, and using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality.

  • Partner with AEs and Sales and Marketing counterparts on pipeline-generation, territory, and prospecting initiatives that support SMB business objectives.

  • Report on team performance, pipeline health, and forecasts to senior leadership.

  • Improve team output and efficiency over time by identifying opportunities to optimize systems, processes, enablement, and AI-supported workflows.

  • Establish and maintain a library of prospecting resources, best practices, and training materials for the SMB SDR team.

  • Represent the SMB Sales Development team cross-functionally with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and other departments.

What You Need

  • Minimum of 2 years of quota-carrying sales experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record exceeding goals

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience building and leading sales development teams with a proven track record of exceeding goal

  • Prior demonstrated success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS companies, and history of consistently performing above quota in an outbound sales environment

  • A passion and excitement for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development

  • Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including executive leaders

  • Proficiency in data analytics tools (ie. Salesforce, Looker, and Excel) and familiarity with email and call automation platforms

  • High proficiency with AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, etc.), with the ability to incorporate tooling into prospecting, coaching, team workflows, and process improvement to drive greater SDR productivity

  • Ability to leverage data to drive decisions, create systems, and identify process improvements to improve efficiency

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, demonstrated through excellent communication and presentation skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with financial services sales in a full cycle sales role

  • Experience at a high-growth startup

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

About the Role

Ramp partners with football clubs to introduce relevant businesses to Ramp and create measurable commercial value for both organisations.

As the UK Football Channel Partner Manager, you will nurture and grow Ramp’s existing UK football-club partnerships. You will work with each club to activate the partnership assets we have agreed—including business-community activations, hospitality, warm introductions, campaigns, and follow-up—and ensure each partnership generates qualified sales opportunities for Ramp.

You will work closely with club commercial and partnership teams, alongside Ramp’s Sales, Marketing, Events, Product, and Engineering teams. Championship partnerships will focus on building repeatable, club-sourced pipeline from UK small and medium-sized businesses. Premier League partnerships will focus on senior executive relationships, curated hospitality, strategic introductions, and enterprise pipeline influence.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role for someone who combines strong partner management with excellent commercial judgement and execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the activation and commercial performance of Ramp’s current UK football-club partnerships.

  • Build intentional, club-specific commercial plans using agreed partnership assets. Plans may include target-account lists, events, campaigns, warm-introduction routes, and clear success measures.

  • Partner with club commercial teams to identify and engage relevant local businesses, corporate partners, suppliers, business-club members, owners, and finance leaders.

  • Plan and deliver matchday hospitality, executive dinners, business-networking events, and other activations that create high-quality meetings and introductions for Ramp.

  • Lead club-led outreach and campaigns, ensuring audiences are relevant, appropriately permissioned, and measurable.

  • Coordinate introductions and follow-up with Ramp’s Sales team so club activity becomes meaningful sales opportunities.

  • Track performance from club activity through qualified lead, accepted meeting, application, and activated customer.

  • Run regular partner operating reviews and quarterly business reviews; use results to improve activation plans and hold teams accountable to agreed commitments.

  • Coordinate internal teams across Marketing, Growth, Sales, Events, Product, and Engineering to support club activations and customer onboarding.

  • Build a deep understanding of Ramp’s products, customer value, and workflows so you can represent Ramp credibly with club partners and prospects.

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in partnerships, business development, partner sales, account management, or commercial strategy.

  • A track record of building trusted senior relationships and delivering measurable commercial results through partners.

  • Strong event, hospitality, campaign, and go-to-market execution skills.

  • Excellent judgement when identifying high-quality prospects, shaping warm introductions, and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfort using performance data to improve plans, report results, and manage to goals.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills.

  • A highly collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively across teams.

  • The ability to manage stakeholders across different functions and keep complex activity moving.

  • UK-based, with flexibility to travel more than 60% of the time and to support evening and weekend matchday and event commitments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with UK football clubs, sports properties, business communities, sponsorships, or commercial partnerships.

  • Experience creating B2B pipeline through events, hospitality, account-based campaigns, or partner networks.

  • Familiarity with the UK small and medium-sized business market and finance-leader audience.

  • Understanding of sports business, media, branding, or investing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every football-club partnership has a clear commercial plan covering agreed activity, target audiences, goals, and measures of success.

  • Each activation has a named owner at Ramp and at the club who is accountable for delivery.

  • Club activity consistently creates qualified leads and sales opportunities for Ramp.

  • Ramp and club teams work seamlessly to deliver events, campaigns, introductions, and follow-up.

  • You can clearly show what is working at each club, where gaps exist, and what should change to improve performance.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely last year and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, and Product teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. This is a key role where you will be uniquely positioned to impact the full picture of Ramp’s growth efforts through systems development.


What You'll Do

  • Own partner GTM systems: the roadmap, the architecture decisions inside them and their operational health

  • Build and deploy the Salesforce automation behind them: record-triggered and screen flows, validation rules, custom objects and fields, permission sets and approvals

  • Own partner attribution from first touch to payout: referral capture, deal registration, partner-to-opportunity linkage and monthly partner payouts

  • Own the integrations across the stack, including lead routing, sequence enrollment, meeting booking, enrichment and partner attribution, spanning Salesforce, LeanData, Outreach, Gong, Chili Piper, ZoomInfo and Workato

  • Prioritize incoming requests against ROI. Make the call on what gets built, what gets deferred and what gets declined, and show the numbers behind it

  • Drive cross-functional alignment on scope, sequencing and tradeoffs and carry it through to closure without a manager in the room

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years in business systems at a fast-paced company

  • Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on experience, plus real depth in HubSpot

  • Non-trivial Salesforce flows built and debugged when they broke, and a clear view of why declarative automation goes wrong at scale

  • A habit of framing problems rather than waiting for a spec: ambiguous requests taken on, decided and shipped

  • Fluency translating business requirements into a solution, and authoring that solution in terms of the outcome it drives and how that outcome will be measured

  • A metric-driven approach to prioritization: requests ranked on ROI, effort weighed against ongoing maintenance cost and the reasoning made explicit to the requester

  • Multi-month projects delivered with cross-team dependencies and no PM attached: sequencing the work, holding scope, flagging risk before it lands, clearing blockers rather than reporting them and keeping everyone informed without being asked

  • Fluency with AI tools to build, audit and document faster and a clear sense of where they stop being reliable


Nice to Have

  • Experience in channel or marketing systems: partner sourcing, revenue share and payouts, or campaign structure, UTM tracking, lead source and multi-touch attribution

  • Cross-functional program management across engineering, sales and finance stakeholders

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling: treating stakeholders as users, shipping in phases and measuring adoption after launch

  • Snowflake, Looker or similar BI and warehouse tooling

  • Working knowledge of Apex or Lightning Web Components, enough to recognize when declarative is the wrong answer

  • Linear or similar project management software

  • Time spent at a high-growth startup or technology company

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

  • Prioritize incoming requests against ROI. Make the call on what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets declined, and show the numbers behind it

  • Drive cross-functional alignment on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs and carry it through to closure without a manager in the room

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years in business systems, marketing operations, or revenue operations at a fast-paced company

  • Deep hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows built and debugged, list, form, and property architecture you designed rather than inherited, and a clear view of how an instance degrades when nobody governs it

  • Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on experience, including non-trivial flows built and debugged when they broke, and a clear view of why declarative automation goes wrong at scale

  • Funnel definitions owned in practice: lead source, campaign membership, UTM capture, and the MQL to SQL handoff, with attribution reporting the business actually trusts

  • A habit of framing problems rather than waiting for a spec: ambiguous requests taken on, decided, and shipped

  • You get in the weeds and build: elegant and scalable solutions, with AI leaned on to automate the work wherever it holds up

  • You dissect a problem, drive it to completion with little supervision, and can explain the tradeoffs to any audience

  • Marketing systems depth beyond the CRM: paid media and ad platform integrations, lifecycle email programs, landing page and form tooling, plus deliverability and list hygiene at sending volume

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

The Applied Science team builds models and tools that solve Ramp’s most critical problems: from underwriting businesses to combatting fraud to making spend management smarter. We’re deeply embedded in the business and provide a quantitative foundation for decision making.

As an Applied Science intern, you’ll be a fully integrated member of the team and own your project from start to finish. Working with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, you’ll translate complex business needs into scalable machine-learning-driven solutions. This is a chance to apply ML concretely, ship code, and create genuine value for Ramp and our customers.

You will focus on exciting problems in areas like: credit, fraud, growth, or our core product.

 

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End ML: own the model lifecycle from data exploration and feature engineering to training, benchmarking, deployment, and monitoring

  • State-of-the-Art AI: leverage the latest Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve novel problems and create new product capabilities for our customers

  • Versatile Techniques: apply the right tools to the right problems, whether it’s deep learning, gradient boosting, or causal inference

  • Rigorous Experimentation: quantify the impact of your work through A/B tests and other statistical methods

  • Collaborate: partner closely with product and business leaders to translate models and insights into actionable strategy and user-facing features

 

What You Need

  • B.S., M.S. or Ph.D. Student: currently pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027 - 2029. Graduate degrees are preferred, but not a must.

  • Strong ML Fundamentals: solid understanding of the mathematical foundations of machine learning, statistics, probability, and optimization

  • Strong Interest or Experience with AI: curiosity and drive to integrate cutting edge LLMs and agents into applied solutions

  • Python Proficiency: good grasp of common Data Science libraries (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, PyTorch, etc.)

  • SQL Knowledge: experience wrangling data in a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Clickhouse)

  • Practical Experience: track record of curating datasets and building/evaluating ML models

  • Strong Communication: ability to clearly explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and use data to build a compelling narrative

  • Bias For Action: a comfort with ambiguity and desire to ship solutions quickly then iterate

 

Nice to Haves

  • Publications, Projects, or Previous Experience: relevant experience applying AI/ML and demonstrating your passion for the field

  • Production ML Mindset: knowledge of software engineering best practices applied to ML including version control (Git), testing, and writing maintainable code

  • Data Orchestration: experience with leveraging modern data orchestration platforms (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Metaflow)

 

Compensation

  • The monthly rate for this internship is $12,500 USD + housing stipend

 

Ramp Benefits

  • Apple MacBook

  • Catered lunches in NYC office Monday-Friday

  • Weekly coffee stipend

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is hiring Senior Recruiters to lead critical searches across our G&A functions. Initial areas of focus may include leadership hiring across G&A or owning searches within Risk and Compliance. Ramp’s priorities evolve quickly, and recruiters will be expected to flex across functions and levels to support the company’s most important hiring needs.

These teams shape how Ramp grows, protects the business, and maintains a high bar as we scale. You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with leaders across Risk, Compliance, Finance, Legal, People, Recruiting, and other G&A functions. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down. You should also be energized by learning new functions, shifting between different types of searches, and operating effectively even when the path is not fully defined.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting within an initial focus area and flex into other business-critical searches as priorities evolve, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

  • Develop real fluency in the functions you support and quickly build context when taking on a new area, so you can identify the signals that distinguish exceptional talent beyond title, company, and tenure.

  • Partner with hiring leaders to define the hiring thesis, calibrate the bar, and translate ambiguous needs into clear search strategies and interview plans.

  • Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates.

  • Advise leaders using market intelligence, recruiting data, and candidate feedback to challenge assumptions and improve hiring decisions.

  • Run disciplined, high-velocity processes while delivering a personal candidate experience and leading thoughtful closing strategies for competitive hires.

  • Move fluidly across functions, levels, and competing priorities while maintaining a consistently high bar for talent, execution, and candidate experience.

 

What You Need

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

  • A track record of independently leading complex or senior-level searches from initial scoping through accepted offer.

  • Strong talent judgment and research instincts. You can map a market, identify meaningful signals, and explain why someone is likely to excel at Ramp.

  • The credibility to advise senior leaders, challenge requirements, and influence hiring decisions through clear communication, market insight, and data.

  • Demonstrated ability to build fluency in unfamiliar functions, context-switch across very different searches, and maintain strong judgment as priorities and scope change.

  • Strong operating discipline, including accurate ATS management, funnel tracking, and the ability to run multiple searches at pace.

  • Strong closing skills, including experience navigating competing offers, senior candidates, and sensitive searches.

  • Fluency with AI-enabled recruiting workflows and the judgment to use AI to improve research, assessment, and execution.

     

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience recruiting for functions such as Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, People, or Recruiting.

  • Experience improving interview architecture, scorecards, market maps, or recruiting processes where structure was limited or still being built.

  • Experience developing AI-enabled recruiting workflows that were adopted beyond your own individual searches.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is scaling the Sales Development org, and we're hiring a Recruiter to help build it. SDR hiring is its own discipline: the bar is high, the volume is real, and the strongest candidates rarely have a track record long enough to read.

You'll work with our Sales Development recruiter, owning full-cycle SDR hiring: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offer close. It's a foundational seat with real autonomy. You'll work as a team to build the playbook. The SD team you're hiring for moves fast, with consistent quota beats and frequent promotions.

What You'll Do

  • Own pipeline hygiene in Ashby, moving candidates through stages, keeping data clean, and flagging what's stuck.

  • Schedule and coordinate interviews across hiring managers, panelists, and candidates.

  • Run clear, timely candidate communication and a consistently good candidate experience, even at high volume.

  • Keep scorecards and business case materials up to date and consistently applied, so hiring managers test the same way every time.

  • Flag process friction early instead of waiting for someone else to catch it.

  • Use AI daily for drafting outreach, summarizing notes, and speeding up research.

  • Support sourcing and screening using LinkedIn Recruiter, AI tools like Claude, and internal data.

What You Need

  • 0 to 2 years in recruiting, sales, or a candidate/client-facing role. SDR/BDR experience is a strong plus.

  • A track record of overachieving against a goal or quota, in any context.

  • Genuinely good at multitasking, with many candidates and stakeholders in motion at once and nothing slipping.

  • High emotional intelligence: reads a room accurately, adapts on the fly, and knows when to push and when to hold back.

  • Trustworthy with sensitive comp and candidate information.

  • Highly organized, catching what's off before it becomes a problem.

  • Strong written communication.

  • Low ego, high curiosity, comfortable learning the craft rather than just executing a checklist.

  • Genuine interest in using AI as part of daily workflow.

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

About the Role

The Money Platform, International team builds the infrastructure that powers Ramp's expansion into global markets. We handle international payments, multi-currency operations, and compliance with regional requirements — the foundational platform that enables Ramp to serve customers beyond the US.

 

International expansion is core to Ramp's growth strategy, and this team directly unlocks it. We work at the intersection of greenfield and scale: launching new markets from 0 to 1 while maturing the systems that already run. The platform we build handles cross-border payments, multi-currency accounting, and integrations with international banking rails — giving every other team a reliable foundation to build on.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build payment infrastructure that works across multiple countries, currencies, and regulatory regimes

  • Design multi-currency accounting and reconciliation systems at scale

  • Integrate with international banking systems and payment rails (SEPA, BACS, and SWIFT)

  • Take on both 0-1 work (launching new markets) and 1-N work (scaling existing ones) simultaneously

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with compliance, product, ops, and external partners to navigate complex regional requirements

  • Own problems end-to-end — from architecture to production reliability to partner integrations

 

What You Need

  • 5+ years of backend or platform engineering experience in high-scale production environments

  • Strong systems design skills — comfortable taking ambiguous requirements and building reliable, maintainable solutions

  • Experience working in fast-moving environments with high ambiguity and independent ownership

  • Comfort with distributed systems, performance optimization, and production reliability

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or capital markets (international payment rails, FX, multi-currency ledgers)

  • Interest in or exposure to international regulatory environments and compliance requirements

  • Research and engage finance leaders through personalized, multi-channel outreach; qualify prospects through consultative discovery.

  • Coordinate with AEs, Marketing, Partnerships, and Events to use warm introductions, executive programs, and customer stories effectively.

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to strengthen research, prioritization, and personalization — validating outputs before using them.

  • Maintain accurate prospect and activity data in Salesforce; use performance data to improve outreach quality.

What You'll Need

  • Proven SDR/BDR, closing, or equivalent quota-carrying experience, with measurable evidence of attainment or overachievement.

  • Experience working a named-account or account-based motion — prioritizing accounts and tailoring outreach to senior or complex buyers.

  • Proven ability to partner with Account Executives on account strategy, meeting prep, and deal progression.

  • Strong discovery, objection-handling, and written/verbal communication skills.

  • A builder mindset: diagnose results, form a point of view, adapt, and turn what works into repeatable practice.

  • Ability to operate independently in an evolving motion — creating structure, managing ambiguity, and raising issues early.

  • Interest in building a long-term sales career and taking on the scope of a Strategic SDR role.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

As a Product Operations Specialist for Ramp Travel, you will help build and scale the workflows that make business travel simple, reliable, and well-controlled for our customers. You will own the operational health of meaningful parts of the Travel product experience, from booking and policy workflows through expense automation and issue resolution.

You will work at the intersection of customer needs, product development, and operational execution. In close partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, customer-facing teams, and external travel partners, you will use data and customer feedback to identify friction, shape the roadmap, improve product quality, and support high-impact launches.

Beyond the Travel vertical, you will contribute to the systems and tooling that enable Ramp's Product and Engineering organizations to scale. You will use AI tools to improve release management, customer-feedback collection, internal enablement, and support processes, while directly shipping improvements that reduce customer friction.

*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week*

What You’ll Do

  • Own the voice-of-customer loop for Travel by systematically capturing, analyzing, and prioritizing feedback from customers, CX, Sales, and internal stakeholders

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to translate customer feedback and operational insights into actionable product requirements, recommendations, and roadmap priorities

  • Build product analytics and use data to identify opportunities to improve adoption, booking success, policy compliance, supportability, quality, and overall traveler experience

  • Own launch operations for new Travel features, from alpha through general availability, including release readiness, documentation, internal enablement, and feedback loops

  • Directly ship product improvements, including UX fixes and operational tooling, using AI and low-code tools to reduce customer friction quickly

  • Design and improve scalable operating systems for issue escalation, incident management, release readiness, supportability, and internal communication

  • Identify and automate manual processes that help Ramp scale while improving consistency and reliability for customers and internal teams

  • Manage operational relationships with relevant travel partners and vendors, including monitoring performance, surfacing issues, and supporting joint improvement plans

  • Become a subject-matter expert in the end-to-end Travel customer experience and connect daily customer pain points to the teams best positioned to solve them

What You Need

  • 3+ years of experience in product operations, product management, strategy and operations, consulting, or a customer-facing analytical role, ideally supporting B2B SaaS or fintech products

  • Experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem identification through execution and measurement

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to size opportunities, assess product performance, and identify customer friction; SQL proficiency preferred

  • Experience translating qualitative and quantitative customer feedback into clear product recommendations, requirements, and operational processes

  • A track record of investigating root causes and developing durable solutions to recurring customer or operational problems

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous and technically complex environments, with the ability to create clarity across multiple stakeholders

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages for product, technical, operational, and customer-facing audiences

  • A bias toward action, strong prioritization skills, and the ability to ship improvements quickly while measuring impact

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, or directly improve product and operational experiences

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with business travel, expense management, travel booking, or travel technology

  • Experience working with external partners or vendors in an operational capacity

  • Experience with Retool or other low-code tooling platforms

  • Experience in management consulting

  • Technical programming experience, such as Python, Java, or React

About Our Teams

  • Spend Management owns our core spend product, including card issuance, reimbursements, and travel & entertainment to control spend

  • Intelligence owns the reporting, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions

  • Bill Payments owns our invoice management, accounts payable, and B2B payment capabilities

  • Risk owns our underwriting and financial products that determine which businesses to approve and how to manage risk

  • Growth owns onboarding, activation and retention products to help our customers be successful on the Ramp platform

  • Accounting owns creating intelligence in our accounting platform, saving finance teams time and money

  • Mobile owns our mobile app development and mobile strategy

  • Travel owns bookings and expense automation throughout a trip

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Weekly coffee stipend

  • One Medical annual membership

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay
